contract_rules.game_moneyline: P(team margin > 0); full game has no ties (overtime), so P(home) + P(away) = 1
contract_rules.period_moneyline: P(team period margin >= 1) = 1 - Phi((0.5 - mu)/sigma); a tied period settles NO for both teams

market_recalibration_C.applies_to: all families (the same logit map), scored weeks >= 6 only

selection_rule.entry: last catalog snapshot 15 min - 24 h pre-kickoff
selection_rule.fee: Kalshi taker ceil(0.07*C*P*(1-P)*100)/100 per order; C = 1, 10 and min(10, displayed size) reported
